topic: The pressure cooker that loves to whistle at the worst moment.

episode.title: If Things Could Talk: The Pressure Cooker's Big Solo

shots.narration: I can ruin a recording without saying a single word.
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, bright 3D cartoon kitchen, silver pressure cooker on a stove beside a recording nook with a microphone, no text or logos.
shots.action: The silver pressure cooker, with big expressive eyes and a small mischievous mouth, releases a narrow puff of steam through its whistle.

shots.narration: They cook dinner here, then expect studio silence.
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, cosy modern kitchen, pressure cooker on the stove, microphone and padded recording chair nearby, no text or logos.
shots.action: The silver pressure cooker, with big expressive eyes and a small incredulous mouth, glances toward the microphone.

shots.narration: [whispers] I wait until they lean toward the microphone.
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, kitchen recording nook beside the stove, microphone with a glowing red indicator, no text or logos.
shots.action: The silver pressure cooker, with big expressive eyes and a small pursed mouth, slowly shifts its gaze toward the glowing microphone.
shots.mood: Quiet suspense, warm light, conspiratorial expression.

shots.narration: Then I deliver my signature high note.
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, silver pressure cooker on the kitchen stove, recording microphone visible beside it, no text or logos.
shots.action: The silver pressure cooker, with big expressive eyes and a small delighted mouth, shoots a tall plume of steam from its whistle.
shots.mood: Triumphant theatrical lighting, silly musical confidence.

shots.narration: Suddenly, the microphone gets its own little blanket.
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, kitchen recording nook, microphone beneath a thick folded towel, silver pressure cooker on the adjacent stove, no text or logos.
shots.action: The silver pressure cooker, with big expressive eyes and a small puzzled mouth, tilts its gaze toward the towel-covered microphone.

shots.narration: [chuckles] Lovely. They soundproofed everything except the problem.
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, bright kitchen with a towel-covered microphone beside the stove, no text or logos.
shots.action: The silver pressure cooker, with big expressive eyes and a small smug mouth, releases another upright plume of steam.

shots.narration: After dinner, I received a private dressing room.
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, later that evening, open kitchen cupboard containing a cool silver pressure cooker with no steam, no text or logos.
shots.action: The silver pressure cooker, with big expressive eyes and a small proud mouth, looks around its otherwise empty cupboard shelf.
shots.mood: Soft evening lighting, comically misplaced pride.

shots.narration: Then I noticed they'd hired a replacement.
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, view from the open cupboard toward a kitchen stove holding a round whistling kettle with big eyes and a small mouth, no text or logos.
shots.action: The cool silver pressure cooker, with big expressive eyes and a small shocked mouth, stares at the kettle across the kitchen.

shots.narration: [laughs] They replaced me with a kettle. Excellent noise-cancelling strategy.
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, kitchen stove with a cute round whistling kettle, cool pressure cooker visible inside the open cupboard, towel-covered microphone nearby, no text or logos.
shots.action: The kettle releases a plume from its whistle while the silver pressure cooker watches with big expressive eyes and a small satisfied grin.
shots.mood: Bright comic payoff, matching mischievous expressions.

episode.endHook: Next episode: the kettle auditions for the same job.
episode.description: A pressure cooker thinks every quiet moment needs a solo. Unfortunately, someone in this kitchen is trying to record.
